name: localUpdate
doc: 客户端本地更新：`θ' = θ − η·g`。
stmt: def localUpdate (η θ g : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: θ - η * g

name: fedAvgUpdate
doc: 联邦平均：`Σ_i w_i·θ_i`（权重和应为 1）。
stmt: def fedAvgUpdate {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (θloc : Fin m → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i, w i * θloc i

name: fedAvgIterate
doc: FedAvg 迭代轨迹（每轮所有客户端从当前 θ 出发做本地更新再平均）。
stmt:
def fedAvgIterate {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, θ => θ
  | (n + 1), θ =>
      fedAvgUpdate w (fun _ => localUpdate η (fedAvgIterate w η g n θ) (g (fedAvgIterate w η g n θ)))

name: localUpdate_eq_subgradient_step
stmt:
lemma localUpdate_eq_subgradient_step (η θ g : ℝ) :
    localUpdate η θ g = subgradient_descent_step η θ g
proof: rfl

name: fedAvg_as_sgd
doc:
**`fedAvg_as_sgd`**：所有客户端同 θ、同局部梯度 g，权重和为 1 ⟹
    FedAvg 一步精确等于一个 GD 步 `θ − η·g`。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_as_sgd {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (η θ g : ℝ)
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) :
    fedAvgUpdate w (fun _ => localUpdate η θ g) = localUpdate η θ g
proof:
by
  unfold fedAvgUpdate
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hw, one_mul]

name: fedAvg_single_client
doc: 单客户端特例：m = 1、w ≡ 1 时 FedAvg = 本地更新。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_single_client (η θ g : ℝ) :
    fedAvgUpdate (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => localUpdate η θ g) =
      localUpdate η θ g
proof:
by
  apply fedAvg_as_sgd
  simp

name: fedAvgIterate_eq_gd
doc:
**迭代形式的退化**：权重和为 1 时 `fedAvgIterate = SubgradientIterate`
    （FedAvg 的每一轮都是同一个 GD 步）。
stmt:
theorem fedAvgIterate_eq_gd {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, fedAvgIterate w η g n θ = SubgradientIterate g η n θ
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro θ; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro θ
      rw [fedAvgIterate, fedAvg_as_sgd w η _ _ hw, ih θ]
      rfl

name: heterogeneity_error
doc:
**异质性误差界**：非负权重、和为 1 时，
    `|Σ_i w_i·g_i − ḡ| ≤ Σ_i w_i·|g_i − ḡ|`。
stmt:
theorem heterogeneity_error {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (g : Fin m → ℝ) (gbar : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : (∑ i, w i) = 1) :
    |fedAvgUpdate w g - gbar| ≤ ∑ i, w i * |g i - gbar|
proof:
by
  have hdecomp : fedAvgUpdate w g - gbar = ∑ i, w i * (g i - gbar) := by
    unfold fedAvgUpdate
    have h1 : gbar = (∑ i, w i) * gbar := by rw [hws, one_mul]
    conv_lhs => rw [h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
  rw [hdecomp]
  calc
    |∑ i, w i * (g i - gbar)| ≤ ∑ i, |w i * (g i - gbar)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, w i * |g i - gbar| :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw0 i)])

name: fedAvg_contraction
doc:
**`fedAvg_contraction`**：同质数据（所有客户端梯度都是 `g θ`）下，FedAvg 一轮
    把函数值差距收缩 `(1 − μ/L)` 倍（步长 η = 1/L，强凸 + 光滑）。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_contraction {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    f (fedAvgUpdate w (fun _ => localUpdate (1 / L) θ (g θ))) - f xstar ≤
      (1 - μ / L) * (f θ - f xstar)
proof:
by
  rw [fedAvg_as_sgd w (1 / L) θ (g θ) hw]
  exact strong_convex_contraction hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ

name: fedAvg_linear_rate
doc: **线性收敛率**：同质 FedAvg 的差距按 `(1 − μ/L)ⁿ` 几何衰减。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_linear_rate {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, f (fedAvgIterate w (1 / L) g n θ0) - f xstar ≤
      (1 - μ / L) ^ n * (f θ0 - f xstar)
proof:
by
  intro n
  rw [fedAvgIterate_eq_gd w (1 / L) g hw n θ0]
  exact gd_linear_rate hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ0 n

name: fedAvg_converges
doc: **ε-终止**：同质 FedAvg 收敛到最优值（连接 `RealConvergence` 语义）。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_converges {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ}
    (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 1) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L)
    (hSC : StrongConvex μ f g) (hSM : Smooth L f g) {xstar : ℝ} (hg0 : g xstar = 0)
    (θ0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, f (fedAvgIterate w (1 / L) g n θ0) - f xstar < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  rcases gd_converges hμ hL hμL hSC hSM hg0 θ0 ε hε with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rwa [fedAvgIterate_eq_gd w (1 / L) g hw n θ0]

name: direction_bound
doc: 带噪方向的范数界：`|d_t| ≤ G + ζ`。
stmt:
theorem direction_bound {d g : ℕ → ℝ} (G ζ : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g t| ≤ ζ) (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g t| ≤ G) (t : ℕ) :
    |d t| ≤ G + ζ
proof:
by
  have h1 : |d t| ≤ |d t - g t| + |g t| := by
    have h := abs_add (d t - g t) (g t)
    simpa using h
  linarith [hd t, hG t, h1]

name: norm_step_split
stmt:
lemma norm_step_split {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η ζ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ
proof:
by
  have hAeq : x (t + 1) - xstar
      = (x t - xstar - η * g (x t)) - η * (d t - g (x t)) := by
    rw [hstep t]
    ring
  rw [hAeq]
  calc
    ‖(x t - xstar - η * g (x t)) - η * (d t - g (x t))‖
        ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + ‖η * (d t - g (x t))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ‖d t - g (x t)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hη]
    _ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ := by
          have hE : ‖d t - g (x t)‖ ≤ ζ := by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact hd t
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hη) _

name: norm_grad_split
doc: 分离梯度：`‖x_t − η·g(x_t) − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η·G`。
stmt:
lemma norm_grad_split {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (xstar η G : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G
proof:
by
  have hB : ‖g (x t)‖ ≤ G := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hG t
  calc
    ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + ‖η * g (x t)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * ‖g (x t)‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hη]
    _ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G := add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hη) _

name: fedAvg_rate
doc:
**`fedAvg_rate`（异质性单步界）**：`hsub` 给真实次梯度，`d` 是实际用的方向
    （偏差 ≤ ζ），则单步平方距离满足

    `‖x_{t+1} − x*‖² ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖² − 2η(f x_t − f x*) + 2ηζ‖x_t − x*‖ + η²(G+ζ)²`。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_rate {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hsub : ∀ t : ℕ, Subgradient f (x t) (g (x t)))
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (_hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar)
      + 2 * η * ζ * ‖x t - xstar‖ + η ^ 2 * (G + ζ) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hnorm : ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ :=
    norm_step_split d xstar η ζ hη hd hstep t
  have hPsq : ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar) + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 := by
    have h := subgradient_descent_norm_decrease (hsub t) xstar η hη
    simp only [subgradient_descent_step] at h
    have hB : ‖g (x t)‖ ≤ G := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hG t
    have hBsq : ‖g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hB 2
    have h2 : η ^ 2 * ‖g (x t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBsq (sq_nonneg η)
    have hsame : ‖x t - η * g (x t) - xstar‖ ^ 2 = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 := by
      ring_nf
    rw [hsame] at h
    linarith [h, h2]
  have hPbound : ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G :=
    norm_grad_split xstar η G hη hG t
  have hsq : ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm 2
  have hcross : 2 * (η * ζ) * ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ≤
      2 * (η * ζ) * (‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPbound
    nlinarith [hη, hζ0]
  have hexp : (‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ + η * ζ) ^ 2
      = ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (η * ζ) * ‖x t - xstar - η * g (x t)‖
        + (η * ζ) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hbridge : (‖x t - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f (x t) - f xstar) + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2)
        + 2 * (η * ζ) * (‖x t - xstar‖ + η * G) +

name: fedAvg_drift_step
doc: 单步范数漂移（异质性代价）：`‖x_{t+1} − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η(G+ζ)`。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_drift_step {g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (d : ℕ → ℝ) (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (_hG0 : 0 ≤ G) (_hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hG : ∀ t : ℕ, |g (x t)| ≤ G)
    (hd : ∀ t : ℕ, |d t - g (x t)| ≤ ζ)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - η * d t) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ)
proof:
by
  have h1 := norm_step_split d xstar η ζ hη hd hstep t
  have h2 := norm_grad_split xstar η G hη hG t
  linarith

name: fedAvg_drift_linear
doc:
**累积漂移界**：单步漂移 `‖x_{t+1} − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_t − x*‖ + η(G+ζ)` ⟹
    `‖x_T − x*‖ ≤ ‖x_0 − x*‖ + T·η·(G+ζ)` —— 异质性使距离线性漂移。
stmt:
theorem fedAvg_drift_linear {x : ℕ → ℝ} (xstar η G ζ : ℝ)
    (hinc : ∀ t : ℕ, ‖x (t + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x t - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ)) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, ‖x T - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + (T : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ)
proof:
by
  intro T
  induction T with
  | zero => simp
  | succ T ih =>
      calc
        ‖x (T + 1) - xstar‖ ≤ ‖x T - xstar‖ + η * (G + ζ) := hinc T
        _ ≤ (‖x 0 - xstar‖ + (T : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ)) + η * (G + ζ) := by linarith
        _ = ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + ((T : ℝ) + 1) * η * (G + ζ) := by ring
        _ = ‖x 0 - xstar‖ + ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * η * (G + ζ) := by
              rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

             
                                        
                                                 
                                                                            
                                  
                                                
                                                          

end Lattice

name: k01_op_error_of_disturbance
doc:
**`k01_op_error_of_disturbance`（核心桥）**：若 `f` 满足
`dist (f x) (f y) ≤ κ * dist x y`（`κ ≥ 0`），则对任意扰动输入 `x'`（`dist x' x ≤ δ`）有
`dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * δ`。

这是 `RealFloatFormat.op_error_propagation`（`:164`）的**载体无关形式**：
把"输入经舍入"读作"输入被扰动 `δ`"，`κ` 保持自由 —— 于是常数族的紧常数可逐字代入。
陈述在任意伪度量空间上，故不预设任何范数/内积结构。
stmt:
theorem k01_op_error_of_disturbance {α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α]
    (f : α → α) (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hf : ∀ x y : α, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ κ * dist x y)
    {x x' : α} (hδ : dist x' x ≤ δ) :
    dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * δ
proof:
by
  calc dist (f x') (f x) ≤ κ * dist x' x := hf x' x
    _ ≤ κ * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ hκ

name: k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist`**：RMSNorm 在 `{‖·‖ ≥ c}` 上是 `(√n/c)`-Lipschitz
的**距离形式**（`dist` 版本），载体与 B 端**逐字一致**，供核心桥消费。
由 `RealRMSNormSharpness.rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz`（`:94`）+ `dist_eq_norm` 直接得到。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    dist (rmsNormE x) (rmsNormE y) ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * dist x y
proof:
by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  exact rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy

name: k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound`（K-01 目标）**：设浮点格式 `F`，`c > 0`，
`x` 与扰动点 `x'` 均满足 `c ≤ ‖·‖`，且扰动尺度
`dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny`（这就是 `RoundOp.err_bound` 的形状，
只是把标量 `|x|` 换成同一载体上的 `‖x‖`）。则

    dist (RMSNorm x') (RMSNorm x) ≤ (√n/c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)

即 **误差放大 = 紧 Lipschitz 常数 × 单位舍入**。这是 K-01 的 C 端结论：
`κ` 由 B 端的**紧**常数 `√n/c` 填入（而非自由），扰动由 A 端的舍入形状给出。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound (F : FloatFormat) {n : ℕ}
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hx' : c ≤ ‖x'‖)
    (hδ : dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :
    dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x) ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)
proof:
by
  have hκ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n / c := div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n) (le_of_lt hc)
  calc dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x)
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * dist x' x := k01_rmsNorm_lipschitz_dist x' x c hc hx' hx
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ hκ

name: k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable
doc:
**`k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable`（判据 T2）**：`n > 0`、`c > 0` 时，
任何有效的 Lipschitz 常数 `K`（即对 `{‖·‖ ≥ c}` 上所有点对成立）必满足 `√n/c ≤ K`。

这把"K-01 的 `κ` 恰好是 `√n/c`"从事后观察变成**可证事实**：
`κ` **不可能更小**，故 K-01 的常数是**紧的**而非松弛的。
stmt:
theorem k01_rmsNorm_constant_not_improvable {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c K : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hK : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), c ≤ ‖x‖ → c ≤ ‖y‖ →
      ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    Real.sqrt n / c ≤ K
proof: (rmsNormE_constant_iff hn c K hc).mp hK

name: k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects
doc:
**`k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects`（负对照 NC-3）**：把 K-01 的常数从紧的
`√n/c` 换成松弛的 `2√n/c`，**结论照样成立**（因为松弛界也是有效 Lipschitz 界）。

注意 **这正是阴性说明**（`三期22-B` §4.2 NC-3）：**光有"能接"不足以证明接得对** ——
只有配上 §四 的唯一性才是真正的判据。本文件保留该负对照，以免读者把
"K-01 能接上"误读为"K-01 的常数是紧的"。
stmt:
theorem k01_relaxed_constant_also_connects (F : FloatFormat) {n : ℕ}
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hx' : c ≤ ‖x'‖)
    (hδ : dist x' x ≤ F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :
    dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x) ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny)
proof:
by
                                                                
                                                          
                                                               
                                                                
  have hle : Real.sqrt n / c ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt n / c := by
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_nonneg n
    have h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt n / c := div_nonneg hs (le_of_lt hc)
    have h2 : 2 * Real.sqrt n / c - Real.sqrt n / c = Real.sqrt n / c := by ring
    linarith
  calc dist (rmsNormE x') (rmsNormE x)
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        k01_rmsNorm_float_error_bound F c hc x x' hx hx' hδ
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (F.eps * ‖x‖ + F.tiny) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle
          (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg F.eps_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)) F.tiny_nonneg)

end Lattice
